events.extended_summary: Nineteen-year-old Carmelle Collado won the inaugural Eurovision Song Contest Asia in Bangkok, taking the Philippines to victory with the pop and rap song Sobra-Sobra. Eleven countries competed at the One Bangkok Forum, and Carmelle finished with 211 points, 41 clear of host Thailand, with Vietnam third. She received the most votes from both national juries and the public ballot. Sobra-Sobra is sung in Tagalog and English and supported by traditional Philippine instruments including the kubing and kulintang. Carmelle grew up in the Bicol region of south-eastern Luzon and has competed in televised talent contests since age 12. She stated the song celebrates female empowerment as a tribute to Filipino women. Discussions regarding the future of the contest will commence shortly, with 16 to 17 countries showing interest in competing in a second edition in 2027.
events.micro_summary: Carmelle wins first Eurovision Song Contest Asia in Bangkok with 211 points for the Philippines.
events.summary: Nineteen-year-old Carmelle won the inaugural Eurovision Song Contest Asia in Bangkok, securing 211 points for the Philippines with Sobra-Sobra, finishing 41 points ahead of host Thailand.

events.extended_summary: Mohammad Javad Vafaei Sani, a 31-year-old Iranian boxing champion and political prisoner, received the Magnitsky Award for Outstanding Human Rights Activist at a ceremony in London and a UK Parliament session. Sentenced to death three times, with the supreme court upholding his sentence on 4 October 2025, he is one of seven athletes at risk of execution in Iran. Arrested in 2020 for participating in 2019 protests, he was convicted of "corruption on Earth." In a message from Vakilabad prison, he stated he would "never surrender" and accepted the award for those imprisoned for aspiring to a free Iran. During the parliamentary session, lawmakers condemned Iran's political executions and called on the British government to prevent his execution, with the government representative describing the executions as a cause of "deep abhorrence."
events.micro_summary: Iranian boxing champion Mohammad Javad Vafaei Sani received the Magnitsky Award while facing execution in Iran.
events.summary: Iranian boxing champion and political prisoner Mohammad Javad Vafaei Sani, sentenced to death three times, received the Magnitsky Award for Outstanding Human Rights Activist at a UK Parliament ceremony, where lawmakers condemned Iran's executions and called for his release.

events.extended_summary: Republican Representative Lauren Boebert of Colorado lost her seat in Congress to Democratic challenger Eileen Laubacher after serving three terms. The race in Colorado's 4th District was called Friday for Laubacher, a retired U.S. Navy rear admiral and former National Security Council member. The district is heavily Republican, having been won by Donald Trump by 18 points in 2024. Boebert, 39, had switched to the more conservative 4th District in 2024 after narrowly surviving re-election in the 3rd District two years prior. First elected in 2020, she rose to national prominence as a vocal supporter of Donald Trump and the MAGA movement, advocating for gun rights and conservative causes. Following her defeat, Boebert posted a farewell video on social media declaring "God's got this," which drew criticism and mockery from users referencing her past controversies, including her 2023 removal from a Denver theater performance.
events.micro_summary: Republican Lauren Boebert lost her Colorado congressional seat to Democrat Eileen Laubacher after three terms.
events.summary: Republican Representative Lauren Boebert lost her Colorado congressional seat to Democrat Eileen Laubacher after three terms. The race in the heavily Republican district was called Friday for Laubacher, a retired Navy rear admiral.

events.extended_summary: Thousands of people demonstrated in Antalya, Turkey, during the COP31 UN climate summit as part of the "people's COP" march. LGBTQ+ activists defied a crackdown on their rights by unfurling rainbow flags while surrounded by a protective cordon of international civil society campaigners. Turkish police conducted a massive security operation, frisking attendees twice, searching bags, and cordoning off a 1.5km route with steel barriers to Aydin Kanza Park. Activists described the danger of displaying flags in Turkey, where LGBTQ+ groups have faced increased persecution since September, with one noting a detained trans friend. Other participants from environmental, political, and workers organizations protested slow climate action and destructive infrastructure projects including airport expansion, a third bridge over the Bosphorus, and mining operations.
events.micro_summary: LGBTQ+ activists unfurled rainbow flags at Antalya's COP31 climate march protected by civil society cordon.
events.summary: Thousands demonstrated in Antalya during the COP31 climate summit, with LGBTQ+ activists unfurling rainbow flags protected by a cordon of international civil society campaigners amid heavy police security and searches.

events.extended_summary: Drone attacks on merchant vessels in the Black Sea have intensified, making the waterway the deadliest in the world with at least 38 sailors killed since June. On October 13, the Malta-flagged Chelsea 3 was struck by a drone 40 kilometres from the Bulgarian port of Varna, blowing a hole in its side and causing it to sink in stormy conditions. Commander Ivan Ivanov's border patrol crew rescued all aboard by having them jump to the vessel, but a second ship, the HS Dignity, also hit by multiple drones, left five rescued and eleven missing. On November 14, the Larissa cargo vessel was struck approximately 6.8 nautical miles northeast of Sfântu Gheorghe in Romanian territorial waters, prompting Romania to scramble two F-16 fighter jets from the 86th Feteti Air Base after another aerial attack near Snake Island, triggering emergency alerts for Tulcea County residents.
events.micro_summary: Drone attacks on cargo ships in the Black Sea have killed at least 38 sailors and prompted NATO jet scrambles.

sources.publisher: ABC News & Headlines – Australian Broadcasting Corporation

events.summary: Drone strikes on cargo ships in the Black Sea have killed at least 38 sailors since June, prompting rescue missions and NATO fighter jet scrambles near Romania and Bulgaria as vessels sink in stormy seas.

events.extended_summary: Wales secured a historic 35-28 victory over New Zealand in the Nations Championship at the Principality Stadium in Cardiff, ending a 34-match losing streak against the All Blacks dating back to 1953. The home side built a commanding lead through tries from Tomos Williams, Dewi Lake, Archie Griffin, Eddie James and Louis Rees-Zammit, with Costelow converting five times. New Zealand responded with tries from Cortez Ratima, Wallace Sititi, Fehi Fineanganofo and Peter Lakai, and four conversions from Mo'unga, leveling the score 21-21 at halftime. Wales regained control early in the second half to lead 35-21 before New Zealand narrowed the gap to 35-28. In the final quarter, Wales defended resolutely inside their own 22, holding the All Blacks up three times over the line to preserve the win. The match drew 55,152 spectators, the lowest attendance for a Wales-New Zealand fixture at the stadium.
events.micro_summary: Wales defeated New Zealand 35-28 in the Nations Championship, ending a 73-year winless streak against the All Blacks.

sources.publisher: ABC News & Headlines – Australian Broadcasting Corporation

events.summary: Wales beat New Zealand 35-28 in a Nations Championship thriller at the Principality Stadium, securing their first victory over the All Blacks since 1953 after holding off late pressure with a formidable defensive display.

events.extended_summary: Usman Khawaja has claimed that the entire Australian cricket team knew sandpaper was being used to alter the ball before their 2018 Test against South Africa in Cape Town. Test captain Pat Cummins dismissed the retired opener's accusation as "100 per cent wrong" and "utter nonsense" during a 68-minute press conference, stating that friends are not casual with each other's lives and reputations. David Warner backed Khawaja's claim, asserting that Cricket Australia's investigation into the scandal "stinks of a cover-up" because it allegedly failed to interview bowlers Josh Hazlewood, Mitchell Starc, and Nathan Lyon. The controversy reignites the 2018 "sandpapergate" scandal involving Cameron Bancroft shoving sandpaper down his trousers.
events.micro_summary: Pat Cummins dismisses Usman Khawaja's claim that entire team knew of 2018 ball tampering as utter nonsense.
events.summary: Usman Khawaja claimed the entire Australian team knew of 2018 ball tampering, prompting Pat Cummins to call it "utter nonsense" in a 68-minute press conference, while David Warner called the investigation a cover-up.

events.extended_summary: The SEC moved the Oklahoma versus Ole Miss football game from Saturday to Sunday at 1 p.m. ET after the Federal Aviation Administration issued a nationwide ground stop Friday that disrupted travel. Oklahoma athletic director Roger Denny strongly objected to the decision, calling it inexplicable and unfair to the Sooners, and noted the school was open to playing Saturday night. Ole Miss stated that after the ground stop was lifted, its charter broker informed the school that JetBlue could not fly the team to Oklahoma Friday night due to flight crew duty time restrictions, leaving no viable travel options before Saturday. The game was originally scheduled for 4:15 p.m. Saturday. SEC Commissioner Greg Sankey informed Oklahoma that failing to play at the directed Sunday time would result in a forfeit. Oklahoma is offering discounted concessions including $2 hot dogs and beer, plus complimentary tickets to other athletic events.
events.micro_summary: Oklahoma-Ole Miss football game postponed to Sunday 1 p.m. ET after FAA ground stop.
events.summary: The SEC postponed the Oklahoma-Ole Miss football game from Saturday to Sunday at 1 p.m. ET following an FAA nationwide ground stop that disrupted travel, despite Oklahoma's objections that the decision unfairly burdens the Sooners.

events.extended_summary: Will Joseph scored five tries on his first England appearance since 2022 as England defeated Japan 78-15 in Saturday's Nations Championship at Twickenham. The hosts scored 13 tries in total, with Joseph recording a hat-trick in the opening 20 minutes of his second Test. Japan received a 20-minute red card to lock Harry Hockings after just one minute of play, and scored tries through Warner Dearns and replacement prop Opeti Helu. England's points total would have been 16 greater had eight conversions not been missed, with George Ford missing six and Henry Slade two. Former England head coach Eddie Jones watched from the stands as his Japan side fell well short of professional standards. The match was attended by 81,552 spectators.
events.micro_summary: Will Joseph scored five tries as England defeated Japan 78-15 in the Nations Championship.
events.summary: Will Joseph scored five tries on his first England appearance since 2022 as England defeated Japan 78-15 in the Nations Championship, with the hosts scoring 13 tries despite Japan receiving a 20-minute red card in the first minute.

events.extended_summary: The asphalt tanker Atlantic Asphalt crashed into the docked cruise ship American Heritage on the Mississippi River in New Orleans at about 12:30pm on Friday while passengers were disembarking at the Thalia Street terminal. The collision flipped the riverboat onto its side, partially submerging it and forcing around 100 of the 191 people aboard into the water. More than 30 people were injured, including 30 passengers and crew and two emergency services workers, with eight remaining hospitalized on Saturday, two in serious condition. No deaths occurred. The Port of New Orleans filed a federal lawsuit seeking more than $1 million in damages from the tanker's owner Nave Shipping SA and management company Thome Ship Management, and obtained a court order to seize the 500-foot vessel. The tanker reportedly experienced a loss of steering before the allision. The terminal sustained extensive damage with repair costs estimated to exceed $1 million.
events.micro_summary: Asphalt tanker Atlantic Asphalt crashed into cruise ship American Heritage in New Orleans, injuring more than 30 people.
events.summary: An asphalt tanker crashed into a docked cruise ship in New Orleans Friday, flipping it on its side and injuring over 30. Port officials sued for over $1m and seized the tanker.

events.extended_summary: Israeli military strikes killed eight Palestinians in Gaza this week, including six at Nasser Hospital in the south on Thursday and two in Jabaliya on Saturday, marking the first attack on a healthcare facility since the October ceasefire. The strikes occurred as heavy rains caused devastating floods across the enclave, directly affecting at least 106,000 people and submerging thousands of tents for displaced families. More than 700km of Gaza's sewage network has been destroyed, while 940,000 people remain in makeshift shelters at risk of flooding. At least four children and a woman died from exposure last weekend as over four-fifths of Gaza's buildings stand destroyed. The European Union urged Israel to reopen all border crossings and grant immediate unimpeded access for humanitarian aid, noting that Israel is blocking 150,000 ready tents and other essential supplies including sanitation equipment.
events.micro_summary: Israeli strikes on Gaza hospitals kill eight amid severe flooding crisis
events.summary: Israeli strikes on Nasser Hospital and Jabaliya killed eight Palestinians this week as heavy rains flooded Gaza, affecting 106,000 people and destroying 700km of sewage networks, while the EU urged Israel to allow unimpeded humanitarian aid access.

events.extended_summary: Authorities discovered a bomb at BioUrja Renewables, an ethanol and alcohol production plant in Peoria, Illinois, on Friday, triggering a mandatory evacuation of a one-mile zone encompassing parts of Peoria and East Peoria. The evacuation order, issued around 7:05 p.m. Friday out of caution while investigating what was initially called a suspicious package, forced residents and businesses to leave immediately. The city offered Manual Academy school as a temporary shelter. Peoria Mayor Rita Ali confirmed the threat was real, stating, "It is real – this is a real thing." Police Chief Brad Dixon announced early Saturday that explosives technicians had rendered the bomb safe, though investigators continued searching the expansive facility for other devices. The evacuation zone was lifted at approximately 1:25 p.m. Saturday after officials confirmed no other explosives were present. The FBI, led by Ryan Presley of the Springfield field office, is investigating and vowed to pursue those responsible tirelessly. No arrests had been announced as the investigation continued.
events.micro_summary: Authorities defused a bomb at an Illinois ethanol plant after evacuating a one-mile zone around the facility.
events.summary: A bomb discovered at BioUrja Renewables in Peoria, Illinois, prompted a mandatory one-mile evacuation that was lifted Saturday afternoon after explosives technicians rendered the device safe; the FBI is investigating with no arrests announced.

James Campbell, from Prestwick, was one of six people killed in the November 7 shooting in the city’s Main Square. He was in the Polish town on holiday with a friend, and was due to return home on Monday. Police Scotland confirmed they are supporting the 32-year-old’s family following his “tragic death”. The DJ played a residency at nightclub AXM, at Glassford Street in the city centre. events.extended_summary: India and the US have sorted out the bulk of the issues relating to the proposed trade deal, including tariff lines, and the deal could be sealed "soon" as talks continue to resolve the last stretch of concerns, External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar said on Saturday. His remarks come a month before Prime Minister Narendra Modi's likely visit to the US for the G20 Summit, on the sidelines of which he and President Donald Trump may meet to review the broader trajectory of bilateral ties and progress on the trade pact. In an interactive session at the HT Leadership Summit, the external affairs minister said the negotiations are approaching the "finishing line", adding that many of the remaining issues are "not so much at our end" and that more changes have occurred on the American side. Investigators said he had come to the capital to target the businessman as part of an extortion plot.
